# skycloak_realm_group_members (Data Source)

Users that belong to a realm group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_realm_group_members" "engineering" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name
  group_id   = skycloak_realm_group.engineering.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `group_id` (String) Group ID.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name.

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address.
- `email_verified` (Boolean) Whether the email is verified.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user can sign in.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `username` (String) Username.
